name: dataverse-plugin-tools
description: Register, profile, replay and step-debug Dataverse plug-ins from Claude Code: the DataversePluginMcp server (built from source on first start) and skills for registering, troubleshooting, Custom APIs, webhooks and debugging.

prt_directory.title: Plugin Registration Tool folder (optional)
prt_directory.description: The PRT tools folder that contains PluginProfiler.Plugins.dll. Empty: the PRT package the build downloads from NuGet. DLLs in this folder run with your Dataverse token: point only at a trusted PRT copy.
